props.name: delay
props.description: Start the lap partway round, so two beams beside each other differ.

props.name: colors
props.description: The lit arc. Two stops, in order.

props.name: arc
props.description: How much of the lap is lit, 0–1. Small values read as a comet.

props.name: radius
props.description: Border radius. Defaults to the card radius.

props.name: onHover
props.description: Run the beam only while the container is hovered or focused within.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stop the beam without removing the border.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the inner content surface.
